name: Animal Tamer
effect: You can tame beasts of the wilderness. When you can corral an animal and herd it into steady captivity where it can be fed regularly, you can start taming it during your downtime. (Taming: see Part 1. Start-of-game animal: see sidebar.)

name: AP Trainer
requires_text: 10 skill points in Expertise or Shamanism
effect: The animal gains the Additional AP 1 story (+1 SP). Only one animal tamed by you at a time.

name: Advanced AP Trainer
requires_text: 20 skill points in Expertise or Shamanism and the AP Trainer specialty
effect: The animal gains the Additional AP 2 story (+1 SP). Can be done on one animal tamed by you at any time. Alternatively give the Additional AP 1 story to two animals tamed by you.

name: Battle Trainer
effect: Your animal gains the Armorable story and one Special Called Shot trait (Pounce, Slam, Winding Attack). These give 1 SP. If it already has all of them, or you don't want the trait, it gains 1 additional SP instead.

name: Animal Equipment Training
requires_text: The trained animal must have the Prehensile Limbs special trait
effect: You trained your animal in basic scientific equipment and weapons. It gains the Tool User special trait.

name: Lab Assistant Training
requires_text: The trained animal must have the Prehensile Limbs and Tool User special traits
effect: Your animal learns what not to eat in the lab and to fetch tools and caffeinated drinks. It gains the Wild Lab Assistant story (+1 SP).

name: Socialization Trainer
effect: You may give animals you tame the Socialized story (+1 SP).

name: Sequenced Orders Training
effect: Animals you tame gain the Sequenced Orders story (+1 SP).

name: Fireproof
effect: Any time you are subject to fire damage or a burn, the tier of your resist improves by 1. The heat and fire soak from your Fire Resistance is doubled (6/12/18/24).

name: One with the World
requires_text: any one Shamanism specialty this specialty can apply toward
effect: You can use many of your Shamanism abilities without moving and without others noticing. To notice that you use a Shamanism specialty, a person must roll a Spirit resist against your Shamanism. Applies to any specialty that calls upon animals through speaking, dancing or other movements.

name: Pack Humanoid
effect: You can act as if you had both the Herd Instincts and Pack Instincts stories at all times (+1 Eva per herd ally / +1 Stk per pack ally within 25 ft).

modifiers.label: per Herd Instincts ally within 25 ft
per Pack Instincts ally within 25 ft

name: Deer Dance
cost: 2 AP to activate + 1 AP per turn upkeep
effect: Trance as a true herd animal: all allies benefiting from your Herd Instincts gain +2 Evade while you dance and until the end of your turn after you stop the upkeep. You also gain this bonus.

name: Pack Furor
cost: 2 AP to activate + 1 AP per turn upkeep
effect: All allies benefiting from your Pack Instincts gain +3 Strike while you use this and until the end of your turn after you stop the upkeep. You also gain this bonus.

name: Scarab
effect: Roll Accuracy vs an adjacent opponent's Evade; on a hit a scarab burrows into their skin. At the end of your turn it makes a random, irresistible called shot against them, and again every turn until the opponent spends 1 AP to remove it.

name: Entrenched Bloodwalker
effect:
The scarab must be cut out: removing it costs 1 AP and causes bleeding from that turn on, every turn until stopped. Bleeding is unsoakable; 1 AP patching stops 5 points.
Bleeds 3 damage
Bleeds 6 damage
Bleeds 9 damage
Bleeds 12 damage

name: Venom Harvester
effect: From a tamed, well-contained or freshly dead animal: roll Sciences (Understand); its tier is the highest venom marque you can extract. Then spend 3 AP to get one dose. Repeat for other venoms of the same animal. Max one dose of each venom kind per animal per downtime. Extracted venoms can be used by anyone like a poison.

name: Expert Venom Extraction
effect: You can harvest one additional dose of venom from an animal between downtimes, if available.

name: Venom Chemist
effect: Mix two doses of different venoms into a new venom class (cannot be mixed further, otherwise normal). Usable with the Venomized augment for doubly-venomized poisons.

name: Bio-Engineer
effect: You can build your own animal from the ground up; only one animal (any size) at a time regardless of DIY. It starts with one special trait known by you; small animals one more. Traits come from a pertinent Special Traits list and are learned with augment points like normal augments; each must give no more than 1 SP. Special traits give no derived stats: instead the animal starts with 1 level + 1 per 2 of your levels, and levels up with you at every 2nd character level after its creation. It acts right before or after you in priority, or on any later turn (your choice). It is tamed by you at once but has no special taming abilities, so it acts as a normal tamed animal.

name: Bio-Engineered Chimaeras
requires_text: Bio-Engineer specialty and 5 skill points in Bio-Flux
effect: Your bio-engineered animals may have two more special traits each, same rules as Bio-Engineer.

name: Bio-Engineered Abominations
requires_text: Bio-Engineer, Bio-Engineered Chimaeras, 15 skill points in Bio-Flux
effect: Two more special traits per bio-engineered animal, same rules.

name: Bio-Engineered Monstrosities
requires_text: Bio-Engineer, Chimaeras, Abominations, 25 skill points in Bio-Flux
effect: Two more special traits per bio-engineered animal, same rules.

name: Bio-Engineer Extra Animals
effect: One additional bio-engineered animal per 6 DIY (2 animals at DIY 6, 3 at DIY 12); identical or unique.

name: Animal Essence Adjustments
effect: During any breather you may change any Primary (size/niche), Movement or Special traits of any animal you have tamed. Changed animals count as bio-engineered for other bio-engineering specialties.

name: Captive Animal Adjustments
effect: You can use Animal Essence Adjustments on untamed, captive animals (an unwilling animal resists with Spirit). They don't count as bio-engineered until tamed.
